newsitem.title: USA: US stock index futures still down after Beige Book.
newsitem.headline: US stock index futures still down after Beige Book.

text.p: May 7 - U.S. stock index futures were lower after Fed's Beige Book. June S&Ps shaved losses slightly. Fed said US wages, retail price pressures generally subdued. US economy expanded at moderate rate through March and April. Labor mkt tight with "a few" new reports of upward price pressure. Also, US sold $12.0 bln 10-yr notes at avg yld of 6.740 pct, stop 6.759 pct. Bid-to-cover 1:.86, non-comps $383 million.
